pages.title: Wheelie Spooky
pages.creator: GM Media
pages.description: Wheelie Spooky takes a balancing-bike challenge onto haunted roads. Control the throttle and brake, stand on the seat, and attempt tricks while keeping the bike steady. Gather coins during rides to unlock additional bikes and Halloween-inspired costumes for the rider.

pages.title: ASMR Halloween Makeover
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: ASMR Halloween Makeover gives Dracula a complete beauty treatment before a Halloween styling session. Clean away stains, remove unwanted hair, and work through body-care activities. Finish by choosing hair, makeup, accessories, and clothing for the character's transformed spooky-party look.

pages.title: Solitaire Summer: Klondike
pages.creator: Playades International LLC
pages.description: Solitaire Summer: Klondike asks you to organize a deck into four suit-based stacks from ace to king. Move cards around the tableau to uncover useful plays and complete the foundations. Work through the familiar Klondike rules against a seaside summer backdrop.

pages.title: Portal Hop
pages.creator: Kankane Games
pages.description: Portal Hop has you carry a portal overhead while solving platforming puzzles. Warp upward through it and collect plus or minus power-ups to change its height. Work out where to stand and how tall the portal should be to reach each destination.

pages.title: Age of Zombies
pages.creator: Yes2Games
pages.description: Age of Zombies follows Barry Steakfries through time on a mission to stop the undead. Use twin-stick movement and shooting to fight across 24 stages in eight settings. Upgrade weapons and abilities while using grenades to deal with the zombie attacks.

pages.title: Italian Animal Alchemy - Brainrot
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Italian Animal Alchemy - Brainrot lets you combine ordinary animals and objects into unusual meme creatures. Experiment with different pairings to uncover more mutants for the collection. Keep discovering combinations as you work toward finding the complete set of Italian-themed creations.

pages.title: Labubu Pop
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Labubu Pop asks you to connect at least three matching Labubus into a chain. Link characters horizontally, vertically, or diagonally to clear them and gain points. New figures enter the box as you build larger combinations and progress through the stages.

pages.title: 3D Chess Master
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: 3D Chess Master presents chess on a three-dimensional board. Move your pieces and plan attacks while protecting your king from the opposing side. Challenge a friend in a head-to-head match or test your strategy against one of the computer opponents.

pages.title: Sprunki Match
pages.creator: AF
pages.description: Sprunki Match turns the meme characters into a card-memory challenge. Reveal cards, remember their positions, and find matching pairs to clear the board. Work through thirty levels and try its two modes as the different Sprunki faces appear.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Ultimate
pages.creator: Bubble Shooter
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Ultimate asks you to launch colored bubbles into groups of at least three. Clear larger clusters with well-placed shots and choose a power-up whenever you level up. Bombs, rainbow bubbles, and other boosters add options for handling difficult arrangements.

pages.title: Sweet And Fruity Makeup
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Sweet And Fruity Makeup gives you cosmetics inspired by watermelon, lemon, orange, and berries. Experiment with lip gloss, eyeshadow, and blush to create a fruit-colored look. Combine the shades across the face to finish your own bright makeup design.

pages.title: Hidden Objects: Vacation in Brazil
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Hidden Objects: Vacation in Brazil takes you through Brazilian locations searching for listed items. Check the objects shown at the bottom of the screen and locate them in each scene. Play accompanying minigames and collect souvenirs during the sightseeing adventure.

pages.title: Nuts & Bolts Sort: Color Puzzle
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Nuts & Bolts Sort: Color Puzzle challenges you to reorganize fasteners by color. Unscrew and move nuts or bolts into matching positions until the arrangement is sorted. Plan the transfers through increasingly complicated layouts and complete the color groups to advance.

pages.title: Pixel Mini Golf
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Pixel Mini Golf offers four hundred compact putting stages across green hills and other courses. Aim the ball toward each hole while gathering coins along the way. Work through the different course mechanisms and try to increase the score from your shots.

pages.title: Stunt Bike Rider Bros
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Stunt Bike Rider Bros combines motorcycle racing and show-style riding for one or two players. Compete with other riders in Racing mode or tackle difficult stages in Career mode. Use nitro and change the camera as you control the bike through its challenges.

pages.title: Screw Puzzle
pages.creator: HolaStudio
pages.description: Screw Puzzle asks you to remove screws from metal plates by moving them into available holes. Select a screw, choose a new position, and release the supported parts. Work out the removal order needed to free every plate from the arrangement.

pages.title: Idle Cat Diggers
pages.creator: Zhivotech
pages.description: Idle Cat Diggers has cat-shaped mining machines working for gold in a large underground cave. Spend the gold on improved digging strength and unlock cats with different abilities. Expand the mining operation by increasing how efficiently your diggers extract the resources.

pages.title: KiSS ME
pages.creator: Yesbol Amirov
pages.description: KiSS ME challenges you to bring a separated couple together through block-sliding puzzles. Move pieces into empty spaces to create a route for the lovers. Keep them away from hostile characters, including positions that bring them dangerously close to an enemy.

pages.title: Click Bubbles
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Click Bubbles asks you to select groups of at least two matching bubbles to clear them. Larger groups award more points per bubble, so look over the board before clicking. Keep choosing useful clusters as you work toward a higher score.

pages.title: Slenderman Must Die: Hell Fire
pages.creator: danygames.com
pages.description: Slenderman Must Die: Hell Fire puts you in a first-person battle to save a town from Slenderman's new fire powers. Move through the threatened area and use weapons against its dangers. Keep track of ammunition and health while confronting the fiery nightmare.

pages.title: Little Panda
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Little Panda is a candy-matching puzzle with forty campaign stages and an endless mode. Form matches of at least three identical sweets to make progress. Finish each challenge before the available time or moves run out, depending on the current stage's restriction.

pages.title: Temporary Tattoo
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Temporary Tattoo lets you run a traveling studio serving customers who want body-art designs. Choose from the tattoo options and work through the painting and cleaning activities for each appointment. Finish one customer's request before moving on to the next client.

pages.title: Steveminer Home
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Steveminer Home sends Steve through a dangerous route while TNT rains down around him. Help him reach home without running into walls or being caught by other traps. Watch for arrow-launching boxes and blades rising from the ground along the escape path.

pages.title: Santa Slide
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Santa Slide challenges you to clear a route for Santa by shifting blocks of ice. Move the obstructing pieces into useful spaces until he has room to leave. Solve sixty sliding puzzles, planning each arrangement rather than moving blocks without a clear exit route.

pages.title: Fighting Stars Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Fighting Stars Jigsaw offers twelve pictures that unlock in sequence as you complete them. Choose a 25-piece, 49-piece, or hundred-piece layout for each image. Start with the first scene and fit its pieces together to open the next jigsaw.

pages.title: RacerKing
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: RacerKing puts your car in an arena where other vehicles create deadly traps. Keep moving around their hazards and create traps of your own to threaten rivals. Survive the contest by choosing routes that leave room to escape the surrounding danger.

pages.title: Baby Taylor Halloween Adventure
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Baby Taylor Halloween Adventure follows Taylor and her friends preparing for a party in a decorated house. Help Taylor and Jessica dress as a vampire and Alice before the celebration. Join their Halloween activities as they plan a surprise for the boys.

pages.title: Jelly Crush Matching
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Jelly Crush Matching asks you to connect groups of at least three matching jellies. Each successful chain awards points and adds time to the countdown. Form longer connections for larger rewards and keep matching quickly enough to extend the game.

pages.title: Castle Blocks
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Castle Blocks gives you architectural pieces to drag into your own castle design. Arrange building blocks inspired by different cultures and civilizations to shape the structure. Combine the available sections into a completed castle using the layout you prefer.

pages.title: Anime Princess Dress Up Game
pages.creator: loko8
pages.description: Anime Princess Dress Up Game offers six anime-style princesses, four backgrounds, and over 240 styling items. Mix hairstyles, dresses, separates, and accessories to create each character's look. Change the setting to show your completed princess outfit against a different backdrop.

pages.title: Oil Tanker Transporter Truck Simulator
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Oil Tanker Transporter Truck Simulator has you move fuel from a refinery to filling stations. Drive a heavy tanker along mountain and off-road routes to complete the deliveries. Handle the large cargo vehicle through the difficult terrain while transporting its load between destinations.

pages.title: Smiling Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Smiling Cars Jigsaw turns cheerful vehicle illustrations into picture puzzles. Select an image and drag its pieces to the correct locations. Match the details of the smiling cars until the full drawing is restored and the chosen jigsaw is complete.

pages.title: city car racing game
pages.creator: chipchop
pages.description: city car racing game sends you onto an endless urban road with traffic and rival cars. Choose a racing vehicle and drive through the busy streets while taking on challenges. Keep the car moving at speed as you work toward a better record.

pages.title: Animal Babies
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Animal Babies is a memory game built around pictures of young animals. Turn over cards to see their images, then remember their positions when searching for partners. Remove every matching pair to clear the board and finish the level.

pages.title: Extreme Car Battle Demolition Derby Car 2k20
pages.creator: Pixel Studio
pages.description: Extreme Car Battle Demolition Derby Car 2k20 puts you in destructive vehicle battles. Drive into opposing cars, attempt ramp stunts, and drift through the arena while dealing damage. Keep fighting the other vehicles as you work toward wrecking the opposition.

pages.title: Easter Egg Lines
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Easter Egg Lines asks you to move eggs into horizontal or vertical rows of five matching types. An egg can only travel when an open path connects it to the chosen space. Plan moves carefully, since unsuccessful arrangements cause additional eggs to appear.

pages.title: Power Boat Racing 3D
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Power Boat Racing 3D challenges you to steer a watercraft through a sequence of rings. Pass every circle along the route to complete the level and unlock another stage. Missing one means the run does not meet the course's completion requirement.

pages.title: Squirrel Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Squirrel Coloring Book gives you squirrel drawings to decorate with your own palette. Select a color and apply it to the picture's different areas. Experiment with combinations as you turn the uncolored illustration into the version you want to create.

pages.title: Zombie Car Smash
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Zombie Car Smash puts you in a yard where waves of undead threaten your vehicle. Drive through the zombies before they gather and attack the car. Choose different cars and use upgrades to help survive the next level's assault.

pages.title: Moto Racer
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Moto Racer lets you choose a vehicle and event before entering a driving competition. Steer through the race, activate nitro for extra speed, and change the camera for a different view. Test your control as you try to outperform the other racers.

pages.title: Cozy Office Difference
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Cozy Office Difference challenges you to spot small changes between two office-themed pictures. Compare their details and mark each difference you discover. Search carefully through the furnishings and other objects until all the altered features in the paired images are found.

pages.title: Tank Shooting Game
pages.creator: Pixellicious
pages.description: Tank Shooting Game puts you in charge of defending your home from enemy armor. Drive the tank, fire at incoming attackers, and keep threats away from the base. Collect power-ups for temporary advantages as you hold off the opposing tanks.

pages.title: Jumping to the tree
pages.creator: Nicolas Tacgorian
pages.description: Jumping to the tree has you guide a gift box across a series of platforms. Tap to jump and time the landings to move toward the final tree. Later levels introduce trickier gaps and obstacles that demand more accurate leaps.

pages.title: Realistic Air Hockey
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Realistic Air Hockey lets you face another player in a puck-scoring contest. Move your striker to defend your own goal and send the puck between the opponent's posts. React to its movement and aim your returns to win the match.

pages.title: Monsters Truck
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Monsters Truck sends a large vehicle along an obstacle-filled route toward a destination. Use the arrow keys to control its movement and overcome the hurdles in its path. Keep the truck progressing through the course to reach the end of the adventure.

pages.title: Run FireBall
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Run FireBall challenges you to stay ahead of a pursuing fireball. Collect coins and diamonds to increase your speed while avoiding saws that slow you down. Keep building your advantage so the burning threat behind you does not catch up.

pages.title: Ultra Sharp Slice
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Ultra Sharp Slice is a physics puzzle about cutting geometric objects. Draw slicing lines to divide the shapes and change how their pieces move. Choose cuts that bring the resulting fragments into the stars needed to complete each stage.

pages.title: Hyper Jump 3D
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Hyper Jump 3D asks you to guide a bouncing ball down a spiral tower. Rotate the structure to place gaps beneath the ball so it can fall to lower sections. Avoid the dangerous colored areas as the helix layouts become harder.

pages.title: EG Linear Basketball
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Linear Basketball lets you draw lines that guide moving basketballs into hoops. Sketch the right slopes so the balls roll or fall toward their targets. Keep bombs out of the baskets as additional balls and hoops make the arrangements more demanding.

pages.title: Teen Patti
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Teen Patti brings Indian poker to a multiplayer table where you can play with friends. Follow the card game's rules and compete over each hand. Choose an avatar and use the table's chat feature while taking part in the shared game.

pages.title: EG Crowd City
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Crowd City asks you to grow a group by recruiting neutral people around the city. Move into the white-clothed figures to add them to your crowd. Build enough followers to take on rival groups as you move through the urban arena.

pages.title: Marie Kondo Clean Up
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Marie Kondo Clean Up combines fashion choices with a session of home organization. First choose an elegant outfit for the cleaning expert, then join the tidying activities. Work through the cleanup as she demonstrates the game's approach to putting things in order.

pages.title: Shadowless Man
pages.creator: Hack TheREALITY
pages.description: Shadowless Man follows a character exploring a world consumed by darkness. Switch into shadow mode and use its abilities to move stealthily through the stages. Try the two game modes while uncovering the mystery behind the character's missing shadow.

pages.title: Chuck Chicken Magic Egg
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Chuck Chicken Magic Egg challenges you to defeat Chuck's enemies with a rebounding egg. Aim the throw and use walls to send it toward opponents outside a direct line. Work through the puzzle stages by choosing a path that reaches the targets.

pages.title: Bella Night Party
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Bella Night Party has Belle preparing her apartment for a New Year celebration with Jasmine and Aurora. Help arrange the party setting and get the room ready for her guests. Then choose Belle's outfit to complete her preparations for the evening.

pages.title: Amazing Word Search
pages.creator: Amazing Games Network
pages.description: Amazing Word Search gives you a letter board containing five hidden words. Scan the grid and mark the answers you discover to earn points. Find the full set on each board and keep searching for additional scoring opportunities as you play.

pages.title: My Coloring Book
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: My Coloring Book offers nineteen pictures to decorate with different colors. Select an image and apply shades to its areas, with additional shapes available as drawing options. Experiment with the palette to create your own version of the chosen illustration.

pages.title: Tanking Tanks
pages.creator: Paradine
pages.description: Tanking Tanks puts you in control of a tank fighting other armored vehicles. Destroy the enemy tanks to carry out the mission of saving the world. Keep engaging the opposing vehicles as you work through the game's tank-combat action.

pages.title: Shark Attack
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Shark Attack lets you swim through the ocean hunting marine creatures for food. Manage health, air, and hunger while pursuing fish, octopuses, crabs, and other prey. Avoid jellyfish, explosive devices, and fishing nets as you search for food and useful power-ups.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Big Cities
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Jigsaw Puzzle Big Cities turns busy urban scenes into pictures you must reconstruct. Examine the details and move the puzzle pieces into their proper places. Fit the sections together until the complete city image is restored from the scattered parts.

pages.title: Marble Balls
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Marble Balls challenges you to align at least four carousels to make them burst and collect orbs. Plan the arrangement before committing to a move, balancing timing with the next opportunity. Work through 99 stages of the marble-based matching puzzle.

pages.title: Space Zap!
pages.creator: Solstice Games
pages.description: Space Zap! puts your spaceship on defense against an incoming UFO invasion. Destroy the approaching alien craft before they reach your protected area. Keep the enemies from advancing through the space around you as you try to hold off the attack.

pages.title: Draw the Pixel
pages.creator: Piponga
pages.description: Draw the Pixel gives you numbered pixel-art pictures to color. Choose the appropriate shade and tap the matching squares, or hold to fill several pixels in sequence. Complete the numbered areas until the full image appears in its intended colors.

pages.title: Wake the Santa
pages.creator: Piponga
pages.description: Wake the Santa challenges you to rouse a sleeping Santa by dropping a snowflake onto him. Remove blocks from the arrangement to create a path for the falling flake. Choose the removal order so it reaches Santa rather than getting stuck along the way.

pages.title: Fashion Battle
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Fashion Battle asks you to prepare two princess sisters for a wedding-dress fashion competition. Select gowns and complete their styling before the gala begins. Create a distinct bridal look for each contestant as they compete for the event's first-place title.

pages.title: Ellie Private Beach
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Ellie Private Beach begins with a search for red hearts before a beach-date makeover. Dress Ellie and her boyfriend in swimwear, then arrange romantic scenery with clouds, fruit, and flowers. Complete the preparations to create the couple's sunny seaside setting.

pages.title: HDPuzzles Food
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: HDPuzzles Food offers food-themed jigsaws to rebuild from separate pieces. Match the sections of each picture and place them where they belong. Work efficiently through the arrangement as you try to complete the dish's image as quickly as possible.

pages.title: Tetrollapse
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Tetrollapse asks you to remove the colored blocks already on a Tetris-style field. Place incoming shapes to complete the necessary rows and clear the arrangement. Increase your score by fitting pieces successfully while working toward eliminating the colored starting blocks.

pages.title: Valentines Day Romantic Date
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Valentines Day Romantic Date combines styling with preparing a dinner setting. Dress the girl in a casual outfit and add accessories that complement the look. Arrange a romantic atmosphere for the couple's Valentine's evening as you complete the date preparations.

pages.title: Blonde Vs Brunette Beauty Contest
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Blonde Vs Brunette Beauty Contest puts two women in a fashion competition themed around the 1980s. Style the blonde and brunette with the available outfits, then compare their finished looks. Your choices determine which contestant takes the week's beauty title.
